batch_label: fix -- mozambique builder/owner + BW three-tank capacity
reason: Three defects surfaced by the 2026-09-23 S4/S5 discovery completion sweep. (1) Nine Mozambique LNG rows named HD Hyundai Heavy Industries as builder; the source names HD Hyundai Samho. (2) All 17 Mozambique rows carried owner 'MOL, NYK'; the source splits them MOL+K Line (Samho nine) and NYK Line+Maran Gas Maritime (Samsung eight) -- Maran Gas was absent from the backend entirely. (3) Two BW LNG three-tank hulls carried 174000 cbm; CSB and trade press both state 177,000.

cells.note: Mozambique LNG 01 (sheet 1184): backend carried 'HD Hyundai Heavy Industries'. iMarine 2026-07-17 states the 2020 LOIs went to 'HD Hyundai Samho and Samsung Heavy Industries ... for nine and eight vessels, respectively'. Samho, not HHI, holds the nine. Prior ref (imarinenews/28729) supported the wrong builder and is replaced, not appended.
cells.confidence_why: a live page states the value (§3.8c) and the value is specific to this cell

cells.note: Mozambique LNG 01 (sheet 1184): backend carried 'MOL, NYK' on all 17 rows. Source: "HD Hyundai Samho's orders involve contracts with Mitsui O.S.K. Lines (five vessels) and Kawasaki Kisen Kaisha (four vessels)" -- so the Samho nine are MOL+K Line, and NYK belongs to the Samsung eight. GROUP-LEVEL value: the source does not assign individual hulls, so MOL(5)/K Line(4) is not resolvable per row.
